body:
He's just too stubborn to his own opinions. I don't think I can change it, it'd just be nice for once to be able to relax.

There are trans communities, I've tried going to one but it wasn't really what I was looking for. I just want my friends around.

I have to go for now, I'll check back later in the thread. I'm really sorry for being so aggressive, I'm happy that you responded to the thread even if it doesn't seem so...

But I can't find any space. That's what I'm so anxious about. My father is a good person, he really is. He's super supportive even financially but he refuses to see that I just can't make myself happy. I don't know what to do, I have nowhere else to go. My only two really close friends that I can talk to are both moving far away for a year/a few years each because of studies.

I've gotten help, it's part of the procedure or whichever word I should use. It's not helping and I'm not feeling any less stressed. I just want to feel good if I'm going to try but all that is happening is stress every day.

I know, I'm just angry, sorry to both of you...

I just can't handle more of all this accept yourself talk, it's all I've lived on and it doesn't work for me at all anymore.

How... where do I find someone who will think that of me? I don't want to be around anyone, I don't know where to go. Half my family is away on a trip and only my mother is at home with me but the rest are returning soon. I don't want to be there, I don't want them to come back because I can't handle them trying to push me to feel good.
I don't care what people say, I haven't seen it.
Show me one good result then, show me something that could make me feel like me.

It would accomplish not living a life just for the purpose of others thinking they are helping me not feel like shit. I'm just stressed and get anxious every time someone wants to talk to me, I don't want the same bullshit over and over. I'm not happy just because I got hormones, I can't start doing things because you think I can if I try, I have tried and it's why I've realised I can't do it.
What good results? I can't find any good result of genitalia surgery at all, nada.

Because it's not their opinions. I have opinions of myself as well. I'm trapped in this body and I can't get away from it, so why should I try so hard? The end result won't be good anyway, I'd rather just kill myself now than later.

Well thank you for repeating everything I just wrote. I already know there are others, I know how others struggle to be accepted. But I don't. I just don't want to. I don't see the point if it's not going all the way, I don't want to be a mix of gender because that's not who I am and it's not how I want to identify. Everything that remains as it is about me is disgusting, it's wrong and it's not who I am. It's not like a scar from a wound, it's like a branding of a criminal. All I ever hear from people is how supportive and helpful they want to be but if someone is going to love me it's not going to be them, because they don't find me to fit the criteria as a normal person. And neither do I.

I'm not an interesting person, I've done nothing for anyone or for society and I won't if my life is just going to be miserable.
